requirements.text: Author the phased implementation plan for the proposal-editor track as a reviewable repository document, following the owner-endorsed order: phase A = the dependable per-property calculations already underway (the in-flight lanes; no new work created by this directive); phase B = a simple proposal editor (building outline on the lot, exterior wall positions, floors, heights; every change re-runs the EXISTING deterministic rules/scenario engine; each variation saved as a comparable, clearly-labeled proposed scenario; shortfalls stated numerically); phase C = assisted PDF drawing import (select sheet, confirm units/scale, confirm which lines are the building outline / property line / street frontage, ask only for unresolved inputs, then the SAME engine checks it); phase D = DWG and richer-model support, only after the confirm-and-check workflow is proven on real architect files. The plan must ground phase B in the existing scenario machinery (services/api/app/scenario/) and the existing evaluation/evidence contracts rather than inventing a parallel concept, and must state the packet-sized first increments with their gate/reviewer shape.
requirements.required_harness: The plan document exists in docs/, is committed and pushed, names phase-B first packets concretely, and is announced to the owner in plain English.
requirements.required_evidence: the committed plan document + the owner-facing summary
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; plan authoring is the immediate next action.

requirements.text: Honesty and boundary rules the plan (and every packet contracted from it) must carry: a proposed building is a third input class - never a city record and never a rule; every proposal-derived number is labeled as a proposed scenario under the D-073-R006 records-vs-allowances discipline; AI may assist recognition (drawing lines, suggested boundaries, annotations) but every measurement and rule comparison runs through the tested deterministic calculation code; a drawing-derived total is never auto-treated as zoning floor area (inclusions/exclusions applied explicitly); supported-check pass/fail/could-not-check stay distinct on screen and no passing subset is ever presented as whole-building approval; disagreements between a survey/drawing and city mapping stay visible, never silently reconciled.
requirements.required_harness: Every phase-B+ packet contracted from the plan cites D-076:D-076-R002 and carries these rules as binding packet text with matching acceptance scenarios.
requirements.required_evidence: task packets + gate reports of the packets contracted from the plan

requirements.text: Scoped hold release, precisely bounded: this directive releases the expansion-planning hold (.claude/rules/expansion-agent-dispatch-hold.md section 2) ONLY for (a) authoring the phased plan document and (b) contracting the plan's phase-B proposal-editor increments under the normal gated process as the current lanes finish. Everything else in that hold STANDS: the 19-task expansion pack and its 9 contracts are not revived, GDS P1-P8 are not applied, no master plan or MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN changes on the pack's instruction, and 3D-massing/visual-scene work beyond phase B's flat outline-and-heights editor stays held pending the plan's own named owner-review checkpoint. Tier D / Section 20 stops, PR #241, and all gates unchanged.
requirements.required_harness: The hold notice gains a dated cross-reference recording this scoped release (the D-040 pattern); no packet outside the released slice cites this directive.
requirements.required_evidence: the hold-notice cross-reference + the packets' directive_refs
